answer.reason: Verses on the queen's visit to Solomon and on Sheba's merchants give the place two events of its own.

clauses.english: sent its queen to Jerusalem to test Solomon with hard questions
clauses.quote: she came to prove him with hard questions

clauses.english: had merchants who traded in the chief spices, precious stones and gold
clauses.quote: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold

doubts: EZK 27:23 and other marked verses may concern a different Sheba or the Sabeans, so they were left out.
JOB 1:15 (Sabeans raiding), JOB 6:19, PSA 72, ISA 60:6, JER 6:20, EZK 38:13 and JOL 3:8 only mention Sheba in passing or in prophecy, so they were not used.
